## Problem Understanding

This slug tracks a gallery-gap around the generalized Stokes theorem. The displayed identity is

$$\int_{\partial M} \omega = \int_M d\omega,$$

with the existing parent formalization specializing it concretely to FTC in one dimension and Green's theorem in two dimensions. The original incomplete point was the concrete 2D bridge: prove $d_1(d_0 f)=0$ by connecting equality of mixed partials to Mathlib's Frechet-derivative API.
